name: s19_terto_arrivals_crossing
title: Three arrivals for Lanzarote by TERTO, an overflight in the way of their descent
description: Three GCRR arrivals converge on VEDOD for TERTO (letter of agreement: FL250 at TERTO, 10 NM in trail), two from TOVRA and one from TAKAV, within a minute of each other. A northbound overflight at FL320 (free route DESUM - VEDOD - SUNID, UN857 being southbound only) comes up from VEDOD against the stream and stays at its level: it is not to be touched. Build the in-trail sequence (speed first, a fan of vectors where it is not enough), and give each descent once its separation is certain - with its descent speed (Mach, then an IAS on conversion), timed, or with a rate, so that it crosses FL320 clear of the overflight. January climatological winds (ERA5): westerly across TOVRA - TERTO.
